# GraphPaper

> GraphPaper is a free study hub for CBSE Classes 1 to 12. It does not host files: it links to NCERT and CBSE official sources (5023 links, 3517 PDFs, 1505 whole-book ZIPs, all re-checked every week) and shows CBSE notices within about 20 minutes of publication. GraphPaper is not an official board website.

## Classes 9 to 12

- [Class 9](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-9): NCERT books, syllabus and official CBSE links for Class 9
- [Class 10](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-10): Board-exam hub: notices, syllabus, sample papers, previous-year papers, NCERT books
- [Class 11](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-11): Science, Commerce and Humanities: books, syllabus and papers
- [Class 12](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-12): Board-exam hub for all three streams

## Study shelf

- [NCERT books, Class 10](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-10/books): Chapter-wise PDFs and whole-book ZIPs, linked from ncert.nic.in
- [Syllabus, Class 10](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-10/syllabus): CBSE 2026-27 syllabus by subject, linked from cbseacademic.nic.in
- [Sample papers, Class 10](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-10/sample-papers): CBSE sample papers with marking schemes
- [Previous-year papers, Class 10](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-10/previous-year-papers): CBSE question papers by year
- [Sample papers, Class 12](https://graphpaper.co.in/class-12/science/sample-papers): CBSE sample papers with marking schemes
- [Percentage and CGPA calculator](https://graphpaper.co.in/calculator): CBSE CGPA to percentage (x 9.5) and marks tools

## CBSE notices

- [All CBSE notices](https://graphpaper.co.in/updates): Date sheets, circulars and exam notices, checked every 15 minutes
